gripOrHq.title: Genetics-Visionary Acquisition
gripOrHq.rulesText: Difficulty of Research agendas is reduced by 1.

gripOrHq.title: Ball and Chain
gripOrHq.rulesText: [Subroutine] For the remainder of the run, Runner must pay [2] when encountering a piece of ice, in addition to any other costs, or end the run.

discardCards.title: Highlighter
discardCards.rulesText: After each successful run on R&D, give the Corp a Highlighter counter. Each Highlighter counter after the first allows you to access an additional card from R&D whenever you access cards from R&D. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

ice.title: Laser Wire
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Do 1 net damage.
[Subroutine] End the run.

root.title: Dr. Dreff
root.rulesText: Whenever the Runner passes the last piece of ice on this fort or declares a run on it when it has no ice, you may choose an ice card stored in HQ. Pay half of that card's rez cost, rounded down, to force Runner to encounter it; the run is not considered successful unless Runner passes that piece of ice. Trash that ice after the encounter ends. Use this ability only once during each run on this fort.

root.title: Omni Kismet, Ph.D.
root.rulesText: Swap a piece of unrezzed ice on this fort with an ice card stored in HQ. The new ice card comes into play concealed. Use this ability only once during each run on this fort.

ice.title: D'Arc Knight
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Trash a program.
[Subroutine] End the run.

root.title: Chicago Branch
root.rulesText: A, [3]: Add two advancement counters to an installed card that can be advanced.
